data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme following Quant based investing theme
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to seek to generate long term capital appreciation by investing in equity and equity related instruments selected based on quant model theme.However, there is no assurance that the investment objective of the scheme will be achieved.
data.exit_load: 0.5% of the applicable NAV - If units purchased or switched in from another scheme of the Fund are redeemed or switched out on or before 6 months from the date of allotment. NIL - If units purchased or switched in from another scheme of the Fund are redeemed or switched out after 6 months from the date of allotment.
